Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: MappingPage
  |   |   `-- Reorganize the overview around CanvasWorkspace sessions and MappingDocumentController. Show MappingEditorCanvas as the editor, with prompt tools, source windows, search, treemaps, the agent bridge and persistence as callers or projections of session state.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [B] Diagram
  |   |   `-- Distinguish immutable revision creation and retention from placement presentation; preserve the content and per-diagram source-evidence model.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [C] FloatingBox variants
  |   |   `-- Keep ProjectedPane as display state, but show SourceWindowPanel rendering its visible source content outside the canvas. Diagram SidePanels belong to presentation alternatives, not FloatingBox.
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Replace DiagramService content-writing calls with revision submission, retention and receiver-mediated installation; preserve version-checked controller updates and separate agent-call commits.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Add diagram batches, variant and alternative operations, CanvasView commands and projection commands under their respective UI or agent entry points.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |   |   `-- Include saved-view and projection checkpoints; neither the editor nor its shapes become a second history owner.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
  |   |   `-- Replace the sole-writer service account with explicit revision creation, runtime retention and generation orchestration, followed by separate canvas publication.
  |   |-- [2] Add: Editor runtime and shape projection
  |   |   `-- Detail controller-state projection into tldraw shapes and edits routed back to the controller; attach from MappingPage's MappingEditorCanvas component.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Source-window rendering and navigation
  |       `-- Detail visible ProjectedPane selection, SourceCodePane reads, reload and navigation, and separate window state; attach from [C]'s ProjectedPane component.
  |-- Unified selection - state, gestures and WebSocket  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: CanvasSession
  |       `-- Add revision-pinned prompt references as a SelectionState consumer; prompt chips and panel visibility do not determine selection membership.
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Reorganize editing around pinned snapshots, resolved templates and references, revision submission, in-place or variant installation, and persistence acknowledgement; retain context validation and request retries.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D1] EditDiagramInput - request domain
  |   |   `-- Add edit and replacement modes, subtree targets, pinned references, template selection and panel-session context.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D2] Diagram edit run - asynchronous execution
  |   |   `-- Include retained variants and context published after acknowledgement while preserving deduplication and safe application retry.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D4] Diagram-edit agent session - runtime model
  |   |   `-- Add template parameters, resolved reference text and panel-session continuity to the existing session lifecycle.
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: [D5] Revision and canvas bindings - output domain
  |       `-- Separate retaining a candidate from installing it: a review variant leaves the live content binding unchanged until application.
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Add create and extend generation, CanvasView and diagram-projection commands, and checkpoint publication to the interface inventory.
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |       `-- Place GenerationCanvasBridge, revision application, retained contexts and idempotent browser receipts under execution and live-state responsibilities.
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: PersistentLayer
  |       `-- Add checkpoint publication, saved CanvasView and projection state, and diagram-context persistence; workspace autosave still does not publish a catalog revision.
  |-- ChangeSession - domain model and call tree  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: [D] Baseline/proposed -> unified review
  |       `-- Add the read-only change-treemap projection of captured hunks onto resolved diagram destinations; it does not create edit anchors.
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
  |       `-- Include CanvasView, projection, source-pane view and diagram-context callers; distinguish workspace flushes from explicit publication and export.
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw) / Projection  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [B] Diagram - immutable content and presentation
  |   |   `-- Show editor rows and geometry as derived placement projections, not another writable content store.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [P1] Presentation alternatives - choose what a placement shows
  |   |   `-- Add inline swap controls and regular or diff SidePanel rendering to the promote, select and project path.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [P2] Review versus presentation - two independent operations
  |   |   `-- Add per-change decisions and repeatable three-way application; applying changes bound content, while selecting an alternative changes display.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Alternative controls and SidePanel projection
  |       `-- Detail placement-attached controls, pinned-part rows and flow or overlay panel shapes; attach from [P1]'s SidePanel component.
  |-- 01 - Saved CanvasViews and branching  existing canvas
  |   `-- [2] Add: CanvasView command and checkpoint lifecycle
  |       `-- Detail receiver commands, controller checkpoints, stashed working copies and persistence acknowledgement; attach from Saved view's checkpoint-history component.
  |-- [3] Prompt composition workspace  new canvas
  |   |-- Prompt draft and reference ownership
  |   |   `-- Show MappingPage selection capture feeding PromptComposerCoordinator's template-backed draft and revision-pinned chips; connect from MappingPage's prompt-tools component.
  |   |-- Submission and status lifecycle
  |   |   `-- Show exact-request retry, generation status and acknowledgement before updated context is exposed; connect to (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext without repeating installation details.
  |   `-- Variant review UI
  |       `-- Show decisions and explicit application separately from presentation promotion; connect to [P2]'s review component.
  |-- [3] Canvas search and navigation  new canvas
  |   |-- Search index and scopes
  |   |   `-- Show MappingPage syncing current diagram placements to the search worker for canvas and project queries, excluding history and source files; connect from MappingPage's navigation-tools component.
  |   `-- Result reveal
  |       `-- Show revision and hash checks, unfolding and focus before navigation; search highlights remain separate from SelectionState membership.
  |-- [3] Canvas and change treemaps  new canvas
  |   |-- Treemap ownership and presentation
  |   |   `-- Show workspace tools hosting read-only treemaps and publishing decorative canvas colors; connect from MappingPage's navigation-tools component and ChangeSession's review projection.
  |   |-- Canvas source coverage
  |   |   `-- Show current source reads, validation against captured mapped ranges, shared-line allocation and mapped-range versus referenced-file scopes.
  |   `-- Change-hunk allocation
  |       `-- Show captured hunk LOC divided across resolved diagram destinations, with unmapped and unresolved totals.
  `-- [3] Focused canvas projection  new canvas
      |-- Projection creation and ownership
      |   `-- Show MappingPage copying selected or highlighted diagrams into an independent child canvas with a blank placeholder; connect from MappingPage's workspace operations and [E]'s coordinated checkpoints.
      |-- Layout calculation
      |   `-- Show geometry-only worker calculation and ProjectionLayoutPanel settings, with controller publication of applied layouts.
      `-- Persistence and navigation
          `-- Show child-only persistence and undo or redo visibility without replacing unrelated live sessions; connect to Workspace persistence flow.
